_comment: FCS curve merger, drawn by emtk.view_form over the app's form adapter (gui/app.py _Form: MergerModel's fields and table, the app's actions). The curves come from the workspace's Input section (the Qt page's folder field and drops are gone), the Use / File / CR A / CR B / Duration table (a click on Use or a double click toggles a curve), the Target field and save, Guide and ?. The custom section status is drawn by gui/app.py; the two plots are dock windows.

sections.description: Load the example, clear, and the help and guided tour.
Example, clear, guided tour and help.

buttons.label: Load example
buttons.description: Write four simulated single-diffusion curves into the settings folder and load them, so the merger can be tried without data of your own.

buttons.label: 🧹 Clear
buttons.description: Remove every curve and the merge (the files stay on disk).

buttons.label: Guide
buttons.description: Start a step-by-step tour that points at the real controls.

buttons.label: Help
buttons.description: Open the help for this window.

sections.description: Pick the correlation curves to merge from the Datasets workspace (drop .cor files on the ChiSurf window to add them there).

sections.label: Folder
sections.description: The folder of the picked curves (the merged curve is written beside them by default).
One row per curve: tick Use to merge it; a double click toggles it; Delete removes it from the list.

columns.title: Use
columns.tooltip: Merge this curve; unticked curves are drawn dashed and grey.

columns.title: File
columns.tooltip: The curve's file (its path is the row's tooltip).

columns.title: CR A
columns.tooltip: Count rate of channel A, in kHz.

columns.title: CR B
columns.tooltip: Count rate of channel B, in kHz.

columns.title: Duration
columns.tooltip: Acquisition time of the curve, in seconds.

sections.label: Target
sections.description: The merged curve's file (Kristine .cor: lag, G, duration and count rate, standard error); the folder's name beside the folder by default.
Save the merge, or save it and add it to ChiSurf.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Write the merge of the ticked curves to the target file.

buttons.label: Save as…
buttons.description: Choose another target file and write the merge there.

buttons.label: 🚀 Add to ChiSurf
buttons.description: Save the merge and add it to ChiSurf as an FCS dataset (Seidel Kristine).

buttons.label: ⏹ Stop
buttons.description: Discard the folder being read; a file already being written finishes.

sections.description: What the merger did, or why it could not.
